title: 第18章 言传身教第19章 炼制元液
content_zh:
饭桌上，福伯再次的瞪起了眼，鼓着气道：“我叫你和孩子说什么来着，你再不说，别怪我翻脸了。”
乔泰苦笑了一下，确实是，他的客气，倒是令到这开心的饭局显得沉重了，便望着肖恩轻声道：“小兄弟，你坐到我身边来吧。”
“嗯。”
肖恩听了，双眼一亮，走到了乔泰的身边。
“呵呵，好孩子，快坐，快坐。”
乔泰和善的拉着肖恩的双手，直到肖恩坐了下来，又是悦颜的道：“喝茶。”
位置面前，是一杯热气腾腾的热茶，茶香扑鼻，肖恩想也没想，端起了茶一口喝了下去，然后微笑的坐着。
突然间，乔泰面色一变，对着肖恩厉声喝道：“还敢笑，不到一个呼吸间，我已经杀了你两次，你怎么还能笑得出来？”
听到了喝声，一股寒意涌上了肖恩的心头，微微一怔，顿时站立起身，对着乔泰恭恭敬敬的躬了个身，一脸真诚的谢道：“多谢乔伯伯指点，小子受教了。”
能够让肖恩叫声伯伯的人不多，福伯是一个，肖恩知道是福伯是因为自己阅历尚浅，对自己不放心，才逼着乔泰教导自己的。
这不是武学，却是比起任何的武学都要珍贵得多。
同时，内心中也接受了乔泰。
乔雅一脸茫然的问道：“爹，你和臭小子俩打什么哑谜来着呢？我怎么看不懂。”
当然，还有乔横，同样的不明所以。
“你们两个也给我认真的听着，我和小兄弟从见面到认识不过是一刻多点，但他轻易的让我拉住了他的双手。”
见到肖恩这么快就能明悟，乔泰欣慰的点了点头，然后正容的道：“还有，桌子上的那杯热茶，他也是想都没想的喝了下去，更比我亲手杀他容易得多了。”
乔雅和乔横这才明悟的点了点头，尤其是乔横，一个毫无心机的粗豪汉子，最容易上这种当。
“杀戮，往往源于贪婪和嫉妒。”
乔泰继续的对肖恩说道：“例如你身上还有别人想要的秘密、宝物、功法、武学等等，甚至你的天赋潜力威胁到别人，都会成为杀你的动机和理由。”
这无疑是在教导肖恩要先学会保护好自己的秘密，才能够避免招惹到更多不必要的麻烦，肖恩一边听着一边感激的点着头。

“杀人，有时候不需要自己去动手，各种各样的阴谋诡计什么都可能随时发生，譬如挑拨，嫁祸，又或者是将你出卖给有能力杀你的人。”
乔泰又肃然道：“还有，假如你得罪了我的女儿，又或者是我的女儿想要杀你，我随时都会出手杀你。”
语气中，无疑是教导肖恩在提防各种各样的阴谋手段的时候，同样的要将对手背后的势力考虑在内。
这是任何时候都无法避免的，除非这世上没有能杀得死你的人。
肖恩认真的听着，诚心的点着头。
言传身教，说得比他在天绝谷中听到的还要透彻得多，同样的，这也是他吃得最珍贵的一顿饭。
“我和你说的只不过是冰山一角，九牛一毛而已，更多的是要你自己去亲身体验。”
乔泰又不无感慨的道：“小兄弟，如果你还有什么想要问的，老夫一定知无不言，言无不尽。”
肖恩点了点头，道：“乔伯伯，能不能和我说一下福伯的事，例如身上……”
“哦！你能感应得到？”乔泰闻言，面上出现了惊异之色，说完，目光望向了福伯。
肖恩点头道：“是的，我能够感应得到，但不知道具体是怎么回事。”
福伯点了点头，这是一个小辈的关心，他不忍心拒绝，同时，他的经历对肖恩来说，未尝不是一种训示。
“福伯是一名炼药师，曾经是这片大陆中顶尖的存在。”
见到了福伯点头，乔泰沉声道：“可惜，在十年前，给自己的弟子出卖给对头之人，在晋级的时候，遭遇到了强敌侵袭，气血回涌，导致了经脉阻塞。”
“从此福伯没法调动元气，没法凝聚出火焰，也就无法再炼制药液。”
顿了一下又缓缓的道：“福伯这次进山，就是因为采摘到了可以治疗他身上顽疾的活脉草，才会遭受到迷雾山脉中的群兽围攻，还好是遇上了你。”
“不过，即便是活脉草保住了，但我们还是没有能力医治得了福伯身体上的顽疾。”
content_en:
At the dinner table, Uncle Fu glared again and said with a sigh of relief: "What are you talking to your child about if you don't tell me what I told you to do? Don't blame me for falling out."
Qiao Tai smiled bitterly. Indeed, his politeness made this happy dinner seem heavy. He looked at Sean and said softly: "Little brother, please sit next to me."
"Yeah."
After hearing this, Sean's eyes lit up and he walked to Qiao Tai's side.
"Haha, good boy, sit down quickly, sit down quickly."
Qiao Tai held Sean's hands kindly until Sean sat down, and said happily: "Drink tea."
In front of the seat was a steaming cup of hot tea. The tea was fragrant. Without thinking, Sean took the tea and drank it in one gulp, then sat down with a smile.
Suddenly, Qiao Tai's expression changed and he shouted at Sean: "How dare you laugh? I have killed you twice in less than one breath. How can you still laugh?"
Hearing the shout, a chill rushed into Sean's heart. He was slightly startled, and immediately stood up, bowed respectfully to Qiao Tai, and said sincerely, "Thank you, Uncle Qiao, for your advice. I have learned a lesson."
There are not many people who can make Sean call him uncle. Uncle Fu is one. Sean knows that it was Uncle Fu who forced Qiao Tai to teach him because he had little experience and was worried about himself.
This is not martial arts, but it is much more precious than any martial arts.
At the same time, I also accepted Qiao Tai in my heart.
Qiao Ya asked with a confused look: "Dad, what kind of riddles are you and the brat playing? Why can't I understand?"
Of course, there is also Qiao Heng, who is also confused.
"You two, please listen carefully. My little brother and I have only known each other for just over a moment, but he easily let me hold his hands."
Seeing that Sean could understand so quickly, Qiao Tai nodded happily, and then said seriously: "Also, he drank the cup of hot tea on the table without thinking. It was much easier than killing him with my own hands."
Qiao Ya and Qiao Heng nodded in understanding, especially Qiao Heng, a rough and scheming man who was most likely to be fooled like this.
"Killing often stems from greed and jealousy."
Qiao Tai continued to say to Sean: "For example, if you have secrets, treasures, skills, martial arts, etc. that others want, or even if your talent potential threatens others, it will become the motive and reason to kill you."
This is undoubtedly teaching Sean that he must first learn to protect his secrets in order to avoid causing more unnecessary trouble. Sean nodded gratefully while listening.
"Sometimes you don't need to do it yourself to kill people. All kinds of conspiracies and tricks can happen at any time, such as provoking, framing you, or betraying you to someone who has the ability to kill you."
Qiao Tai said solemnly: "Also, if you offend my daughter, or if my daughter wants to kill you, I will kill you at any time."
His tone undoubtedly taught Sean that when he was wary of all kinds of conspiracy methods, he should also take the forces behind his opponents into consideration.
This is inevitable at any time, unless there is no one in the world who can kill you.
Sean listened carefully and nodded sincerely.
The words and deeds were much more thorough than what he heard in Tianjue Valley. Similarly, this was also the most precious meal he had eaten.
"What I tell you is just the tip of the iceberg, just a drop in the bucket. It's more for you to experience it yourself."
Qiao Tai said with emotion: "Little brother, if you have anything else you want to ask, I will definitely tell you everything I know."
Sean nodded and said, "Uncle Qiao, can you tell me something about Uncle Fu, such as..."
"Oh! Can you sense it?" When Qiao Tai heard this, a look of surprise appeared on his face. After speaking, he looked at Uncle Fu.
Sean nodded.: "Yes, I can sense it, but I don't know what exactly is going on."
Fu Bo nodded. This was the concern of a junior and he couldn't bear to refuse. At the same time, his experience was a lesson to Sean.
"Fu Bo is an alchemist and was once the top being in this continent."
Seeing Uncle Fu nodding, Qiao Tai said in a deep voice: "Unfortunately, ten years ago, he betrayed his disciple to the enemy. When he was promoted, he was attacked by a powerful enemy, and his energy and blood surged back, causing the meridians to be blocked."
"From now on, Uncle Fu can't mobilize his vitality, can't condense the flames, and can no longer make medicinal liquids."
He paused and then said slowly: "Uncle Fu went into the mountains this time because he picked the living vein grass that can cure his stubborn diseases, so he was besieged by the beasts in the misty mountains. Fortunately, he met you."
"However, even if the Living Pulse Grass is saved, we still don't have the ability to cure Fu Bo's serious physical illness."
